title: Nutty German Bao
description: Soft, fluffy bao filled with a sweet and crunchy German-inspired nut filling.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water to form a dough.
2. Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
3. Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape into balls.
4. Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of sugar in the center.
5. Fold the dough over the sugar to form a bun shape.
6. Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake the buns in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes.
8. While the buns are baking, mix together the velvety and nutty ingredients in a bowl.
9. Once the buns are done, let them cool for 5 minutes before slicing in half.
10. Spread a layer of the velvety mixture on the bottom half of each bun.
11. Top with the top half of the bun.
12. Drizzle with a little bit of german glaze (store-bought or homemade).
